headline_item.event_summary_en:
Nov 19 (Reuters) - Anthropic's record $81 billion IPO brings to Wall Street an avatar of a sector that proponents herald as an economic panacea, while detractors warn it has stoked a market bubble and could ultimately threaten humanity itself.

More immediately, the Claude chatbot maker's debut after securing a $1.5 trillion valuation in the IPO, together with Tuesday's earnings report by AI poster child Nvidia, signals the industry has nominally passed the two big tests facing it this week.

celebrity.author: Aravind Srinivas
celebrity.quote_zh: 分享关于困惑计算机中自我提高技能的新研究。 Brain 已经维护了一个关于您工作的知识维基，现在还根据您过去的会话为您编写和更新代理技能。改进代理会读取完整的会话轨迹（工具调用、推理、结果），找到重复出现的模式，并且仅在有足够证据时才提出新技能或更新。在任何更改生效之前，每个用户都会通过故障场景的配对重放和工程师审查来获得内置技能。在一项为期 8 周的生产流量随机测试中，72.9% 的用户至少获得了一项新的个人技能，而手动添加一项的用户只有 6.5%。工具调用失败率下降了 11%，不满意的线程下降了 7.6%，而成本或延迟没有明显变化。
celebrity.quote_en: Sharing new research on self-improving skills in Perplexity Computer. Brain, which already maintains a knowledge wiki about your work, now also writes and updates agent skills for you based on your past sessions. An improvement agent reads the full session trajectories (tool calls, reasoning, results), finds recurring patterns, and only proposes a new skill or an update when there’s enough evidence. Built-in skills that every user gets go through paired replay on failure scenarios and engineer review before any change goes live. In an 8-week randomized test on production traffic, 72.9% of users got at least one new personal skill vs 6.5% who added one manually. Tool call failures dropped 11% and dissatisfied threads dropped 7.6%, with no measurable change in cost or latency.
celebrity.thesis_zh: 深入探讨智能体架构与协同的关键演进，直指核心工程落地与技术范式转移。
celebrity.thesis_en: Dissecting crucial inflection points in Agentic Workflows, highlighting system trade-offs and engineering shifts.

何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

titans.event_context_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponent
titans.quote_zh:
我们正在 OpenAI 上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现研究人员对人工智能的使用持续呈指数级增长，智能体正在完成更长的任务，但人类的参与仍然是研究的核心。研究人员也在安全和协调上花费了更多的时间，人类在这些领域的努力比任何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.quote_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and alignment, with human effort in these areas growing faster than in any other individual research area.

This report aims to increase transparency around research acceleration and inform the governance of increasingly capable AI. We believe that AI labs should be required to track and publicly report indicators of recursive self-improvement (RSI): the process by which AI accelerates the development of future AI systems. 

Our hope is that this expanded report will help sustain and advance shared measurement norms across the industry.
